brief:
Israeli military escalation in Gaza, the West Bank, and occupied Jerusalem follows a strategic equation aimed at changing facts on the ground, primarily through forced displacement, according to Mamoun Abu Amer, an expert on Israeli affairs, Shehab Wire reported. The escalation represents a core driver of occupation policy targeting demographic shifts in Palestinian territories.

Abu Amer characterized the ongoing military operations as part of a broader strategic framework rather than isolated incidents, linking military tactics directly to displacement objectives across multiple Palestinian areas.
